# Census Bureau

The Census Bureau Data API provides developers with access to a wide range of statistical data collected by the U.S. Census Bureau, facilitating integration into applications and data visualizations.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/census-bureau/.

## Actions

- **Get ACS 1-Year Estimates** (read-only): Retrieve 1-year american community survey (acs) estimates for a specified geography.
- **Get ACS 5-Year Estimates** (read-only): Retrieve 5-year american community survey estimates for a specified year.
- **Get American Business Survey** (read-only): Retrieve annual business survey (abs) data for a specified year and endpoint.
- **Get Community Resilience Estimates** (read-only): Retrieve community resilience estimates for a specified year.
- **Get County Business Patterns** (read-only): Retrieve county business patterns (cbp) data for a specified year.
- **Get Decennial Census Data** (read-only): Retrieve decennial census data for a specified vintage and dataset.
- **Get Population Estimates** (read-only): Retrieve population estimates program (pep) data for a specified vintage and dataset.
- **Get Variable Details** (read-only): Retrieve metadata for a specific variable in a census dataset for a given year.
